Definition: adverb from G1482; as a Gentile:--after the manner of Gentiles.
BiblicalUsage: ethnikōs is the word for as a Gentile. It occurs just once, in Galatians.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold ethnikōs to its plain sense and let the passage speak for itself.
